messages.text: checking — pods healthy, DB fine… connections to pgbouncer pinned at 200
found it. yesterday's pgbouncer upgrade reset max_client_conn to default
root cause: upgrade wiped our custom pool config. careful — the helm value is IGNORED unless pgbouncer.customIni is set. that's the trap
nice catch. we hit this in 2023 too… nobody wrote it down 😅

captured.headline: The pool value is IGNORED unless pgbouncer.customIni is set
captured.detail: The pgbouncer upgrade resets the pool config to defaults. Setting the helm value alone does nothing — it is silently discarded unless pgbouncer.customIni is also set.
captured.author: priya.raman
